sections.title: Massachusetts property tax: state rules: figures under review

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Cities and towns (351 municipalities); there is no state property tax
rows.note: Local assessors value property; the Division of Local Services certifies values and tax rates. Seen only in a search snippet.

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Massachusetts Department of Revenue, Division of Local Services (DLS)
rows.note: DLS certifies municipal valuations and tax rates and enforces the Proposition 2½ levy limits. Seen only in a search snippet.

source.title: Mass.gov (Division of Local Services): FY2026 Tax Levies, Assessed Values and Tax Rates

rows.label: Levy limits (Proposition 2½)
rows.value: A municipality's levy may not exceed 2.5% of the full and fair cash value of its taxable property (levy ceiling), and the annual levy limit may grow only 2.5% a year plus new growth unless voters approve an override
rows.note: G.L. c. 59 s. 21C. Overrides can raise the levy limit but never above the ceiling. Seen only in search snippets of DLS material.
